brand.title: Sabuy MDM Web Hub
brand.homeTagline: Phase 4 — fleet map, location history, health checks

login.title: Operator gate
login.hint: Set OPERATOR_PASSWORD in the server env. In local development the gate stays open until that variable is set.

hints.fleet: Online means last_heartbeat within 15 minutes. Low battery is under 20%. Agent office still lives on the console. Fleet map plots the latest GPS pin per device.
hints.map: Latest GPS per device from location_logs. Green pins are online (heartbeat within 15 minutes); gray pins are offline.
hints.provisioning: Scan the QR on a factory-reset device. Set DPC_COMPONENT_NAME, DPC_APK_URL, and host the APK so the checksum is computed from real bytes. Local/CI may use fixtures/provisioning-apk-stub.bin.
hints.settings: Publish APK metadata without redeploying the hub. Devices poll GET /api/version.json from UpdateWorker.
hints.console: Policy writes live on the fleet dashboard. Zero-Touch QR lives on /provisioning. Set OPERATOR_PASSWORD before publishing admin routes.

fleet.title: Fleet
fleet.emptyNone: No heartbeats yet. Devices appear after POST /api/heartbeat.

device.name: Name
device.noHeartbeat: No heartbeat row yet. Policy can still be saved — PolicySyncWorker may run before the first heartbeat.

policy.title: Remote policy
policy.subtitle: Writes policies and bumps updated_at
policy.previewSubtitle: Preview — write path lands with operator auth
policy.kioskInvariant: Locktask on with an empty package is invalid. Security desk will reject it.
policy.kioskRequired: kioskPackage is required when kioskMode is true
policy.saved: Policy saved. Devices pick this up on the next PolicySyncWorker poll.

provisioning.step1Body: Factory-reset the Android device so it returns to the welcome screen.
provisioning.step2Body: On the welcome screen, tap the same spot six times to open QR setup.
provisioning.step3Body: Scan this QR. The device downloads the DPC APK, verifies the checksum, and becomes Device Owner.
provisioning.hint: QR encodes Android Enterprise extras. Checksum is SHA-256 (base64url) of the published APK — not typed by hand.
provisioning.printHint: Scan on a factory-reset Android device to become Device Owner.

settings.releaseSubtitle: Publishes the active row served by GET /api/version.json
settings.published: Release published. UpdateWorker picks this up on the next poll.

map.empty: No GPS yet. Pins appear after heartbeats include latitude and longitude.
map.historyEmpty: No GPS breadcrumbs yet. Heartbeats with latitude and longitude appear here as a route.
